mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mq_consume_log (event_id, trace_id, topic, tag, consumer_group, business_key, consume_status, retry_count, consume_started_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{traceId}, #{topic}, #{tag}, #{consumerGroup}, #{businessKey}, 'PROCESSING', 0, #{consumeStartedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE consume_status = IF(consume_status = 'SUCCESS', consume_status, 'PROCESSING'), retry_count = IF(consume_status = 'SUCCESS', retry_count, retry_count + 1), consume_started_at = IF(consume_status = 'SUCCESS', consume_started_at, VALUES(consume_started_at)), consume_finished_at = IF(consume_status = 'SUCCESS', consume_finished_at, NULL), duration_ms = IF(consume_status = 'SUCCESS', duration_ms, NULL), error_message = IF(consume_status = 'SUCCESS', error_message, NULL), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE mq_consume_log SET consume_status = 'SUCCESS', consume_finished_at = #{consumeFinishedAt}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, error_message = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND consumer_group = #{consumerGroup}
